critical_bugs: Unhandled json.JSONDecodeError will crash execution if vla_behavior_matrix.json is malformed, empty, or contains invalid JSON syntax
Hardcoded Windows absolute path (D:\kiarash\...) causes immediate failure on Linux/ROS environments standard for MiR100 deployment and breaks portability
warnings: No type validation for matrix values; assumes all entries are dictionaries, risking AttributeError if JSON schema changes
Hardcoded target scenario count (22) makes coverage calculation brittle and non-scalable as the curriculum expands
Coverage percentage calculation lacks bounds checking; could exceed 100% or produce misleading metrics if covered set grows beyond expected scope
recommendations: Replace hardcoded ROOT with environment variables, argparse, or a centralized config file to support cross-platform robot deployment
Wrap json.load() in try/except block to catch JSONDecodeError and ValueError, returning a structured error message instead of crashing
Add isinstance(data, dict) validation before calling .get() on matrix values to prevent runtime type errors
Externalize magic numbers like 22 into configuration parameters or derive them dynamically from the behavior matrix schema
Consider adding logging instead of print statements for better integration with ROS/system monitoring tools
